title: 65_HS1-834228961_62-HQ-83894_SUB_A
doc_notes: This is a collection of FBI file clippings and reports regarding UFO sightings, including several reports of close encounters and physical effects. / This document is a collection of FBI case files and newspaper clippings regarding flying saucer reports, containing multiple accounts of close encounters and sightings.

encounters.summary: Reinhold O. Schmidt claimed to have encountered a cigar-shaped craft and its six occupants in a field near Kearney, Nebraska.
encounters.communication_content: Occupants spoke High German and English; told him he had nothing to fear and would find out more in a couple of weeks.
encounters.entity_appearance: Four men and two women in business suits.
encounters.entity_behavior: Waved a flashlight, searched claimant for weapons, moved by stepping into specific locations.
encounters.quote: I couldn't move. I don't know whether I was just afraid or what, but it was like being paralyzed

encounters.summary: James Stokes reported an egg-shaped object that caused car engines to stall near White Sands Proving Grounds.
A Civil Service worker reported an egg-shaped object landing in a ravine near San Antonio, causing his car engine and lights to fail.
encounters.quote: egg-shaped object land in a ravine

encounters.summary: Sheriff Weir Clem and several motorists reported an egg-shaped object that caused car engines and headlights to fail.
encounters.entity_appearance: Egg-shaped, glowing like a blinding-red sunset or neon light.
encounters.quote: mysterious egg-shaped object which looked like a blinding-red sunset

encounters.summary: Herbert Long reported an egg-shaped object sitting in the road that caused his engine and lights to fail.
encounters.entity_appearance: Egg-shaped, 200 feet long, glowing like a neon light.
encounters.quote: glowed intermittently like a blinding neon light

encounters.summary: Herbert Long reported seeing a parked saucer-shaped craft 30 feet from his car.
encounters.entity_appearance: Dome-shaped with three window-like openings and an antenna.

encounters.summary: Four Philadelphia policemen reported seeing a saucer-like object land in a field, which then evaporated, leaving a sticky, odorless residue.
Pilot Jim Graham claimed a 'flying sausage' collided with his plane and exploded like a bomb, though no damage was found.
encounters.entity_appearance: blue streak about 10 feet long shaped like a sausage
encounters.entity_behavior: dived suddenly and collided with plane

encounters.summary: Two pilots and an electronics instructor tracked a helmet-shaped object on radar for eight miles and observed it visually.
encounters.entity_appearance: helmet-shaped, shiny round object, 25 to 45 feet across, 7 feet high

encounters.summary: Capt. Thomas Mantell died after pursuing a metallic object he described as a silver ice cream cone topped with red.
encounters.quote: The thing looks metallic and is tremendous.

encounters.summary: Airline pilots Chiles and Whitted reported a cigar-shaped object with orange flames that rocked their DC-3.
encounters.quote: There was a tremendous burst of orange flame from the rear.

encounters.summary: Airline pilots Adams and Anderson reported a flying saucer with windows on the bottom and a blinking light on top.
encounters.quote: I've been a sceptic all my life about such things, but what can you do when you see a thing like that?
